author: Ashley Dutton
text: Rob and Christina were so professional and great to work with.  My experience with Wee Bee was very positive.  They showed up on time, were very communicative and so different from every other septic company I have worked with.  I really appreciate how helpful and kind they both were.  Highly recommend!

author: Linda Ellis
text: Yesterday afternoon we discovered our septic tank needed pumping so l called Wee Bee & they came out 1st thing this morning & got it done!  Very thankful for their quick responce.

author: Nancy King
text: Rob came soon after I called and worked efficiently and thoroughly to clean out our septic tank. His friendly attitude and competence were super!

author: J G
text: Wee Bee Waste Services is amazing!  Extremely thorough and quick.  Rob really wanted to make sure the job was done right and communicated what was happening the whole time.  I am very pleased with the quality of work!  If you are looking for someone in the Austin area, look no further.

author: Kevin Zenor
text: Rob and his team did an amazing job! Scheduling was simple, the service was amazing and they knocked it out so fast! I needed a last minute clean up and they were there the next day. Could not be happier, saved me a ton of time and effort. Will be using him moving forward for all of my surface cleanings.
